Stay in the old town (Ribeira) or near Aliados/São Bento for walkability. Mid-range hotels and guesthouses run roughly €80–150/night in shoulder season; book early for summer. Good area picks: Ribeira (riverside, lively) or Clérigos (quiet, close to everything).
